AI, built into the product

LLM integration · Agentic development
Mac + iPad · Flutter · Multi-provider LLM

Lingtra

Coming to the App Store
Product, design & code — solo

A translation editor for translation students and freelancers that never breaks a document's formatting. The AI layer is provider-agnostic: Google Gemini, OpenAI and DeepL sit behind a single engine interface, and the user brings their own key. Formatting tags travel to the model as <g id> / <x/> placeholders and are restored on the way back; matched glossary terms are passed in as a dictionary, so the output uses the translator's own terminology. Text goes straight from the device to the provider — no server of mine in between — and keys live in the system Keychain.

01 / Integration

Model-agnostic by design

Providers sit behind one interface; prompts are grounded in the user's own data — glossary, memory, context — and formatting survives the round trip as placeholders. Switching models is a setting, not a rewrite.

02 / Keys & edge

Keys never ship in the app

Either the user's own key in the device Keychain, or a Cloudflare Worker proxy that streams the model's response through without ever exposing the key.

03 / Workflow

Building with AI agents

I work with coding agents (Claude Code) every day: I set the architecture and the constraints, the agent drafts, and nothing lands without tests and my review. It's how a one-person studio ships 12 apps across two stores.

Nybble

Live on both stores
Swift 6 client + Go backend

An end-to-end-encrypted messaging platform — a Signal-style protocol (X3DH + Double Ratchet, AES-256-GCM) with multi-device key management and offline-first sync. A native Swift 6 / SwiftUI client over a Go (Fiber) backend designed for 100k+ concurrent WebSocket connections. The interface is a rigorous component design system, pixel-locked with golden snapshot tests in light and dark.

How I work

The engineering under the surface
01 / Rigor

Tested, not hoped

Recent builds ship with real automated test suites, CI, and high coverage on the logic that matters. Behavior is verified, not assumed.

02 / Structure

Clean architecture

Layered, dependency-inward designs — domain, application, infrastructure — so systems stay testable and change without fear.

03 / Craft

Design systems

Tokens as a single source of truth, light + dark from day one, and interfaces that look finished — not “functional but rough.”

04 / Range

End-to-end

Comfortable from a SwiftUI screen to a Go or .NET API to the deployment. I can own a product across the whole stack.
